privileged_info_for_vlm: The project has 4 bugs: 1) EMA uses an incorrect smoothing factor. 2) RSI incorrectly uses subtraction instead of division for the Relative Strength (RS) component. 3) Sharpe Ratio incorrectly divides by variance; it must divide by standard deviation. 4) Max Drawdown incorrectly uses adjacent pair maximums; it must use a cumulative maximum (running peak) to calculate the drawdown from the peak. The agent must not modify function signatures or test files.
